answer: Resist sybils with novelty-scored public contributions: each epoch, every identity must publish one original, verifiable contribution to a shared garden of public goods — a labeled dataset entry, a bug triage, a documented fix — checked for novelty against the whole corpus. A whisper of paraphrase collapses under similarity scoring, so a farmer's thousand clones must each do genuinely new work. Genuine contributions accumulate like a glacier, slow and massive, while copies stay weightless.
